About the role
 

Are you a motivated student with a passion for Human Resources and looking to gain hands-on experience in an international environment? We are looking for an enthusiastic 
HR Intern to join our Benelux HR team.
 

As an 
HR Intern Benelux, you will support the day-to-day HR activities across the Benelux region. Based in 
Belgium, you will regularly provide on-site support at our 
Brussels office as well as at our 
Dutch-speaking production sites.
 

This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain exposure to a broad range of HR processes while working in a dynamic and multicultural organization.
 

 
 

We count on you to:
 
 

• Support the HR team with daily HR administration. 

• Assist & Support onboarding and offboarding activities. 

• Contribute to learning and development initiatives and HR project & HR processes. 

• Prepare and maintain HR documentation. 

• Assist with internal HR communications and employee engagement initiatives. 

• Provide regular support at our Brussels office and Dutch-speaking production sites. 

• Contribute ideas to improve and optimize HR processes.  

 
 

 
 

You can count on us to :
 

During the internship, the HR Intern will receive training in the following areas:
 
 

• HR Fundamentals 

• HR Systems & Digital Tools 

• Operational HR 

• Professional Skills 

• Compliance & Safety  

 
 

 
 

You will bring:
 
 

• You are currently 
pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Human Resource Management, Business Administration (HR), Psychology, or a related field. 

• You are based in 
Belgium. 

• You are fluent in 
Dutch, French, and English, both spoken and written. 

• You are organized, accurate, and able to handle confidential information with discretion. 

• You are proactive, eager to learn, and enjoy working in a team. 

• You are interested in gaining practical HR experience within an international organization. 

• You are willing to travel regularly between our Belgian locations.  

 
 

 
 

You will get:
 
 

• A valuable internship in an international and dynamic organization. 

• Coaching and guidance from experienced HR professionals. 

• Exposure to various HR disciplines and projects. 

• A diverse and challenging internship with room for initiative and personal development. 

• An opportunity to build your professional network within the Benelux organization. 

• An Internship allowance and benefits. The Belgian gross monthly allowance can range from 500€ to 1100€.  Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, qualification, type of Internship agreement, internal equity and can ultimately be more or less than the posted salary range.  

 
 

 
 

Additional information:
 
 

• Location: Brussels 

• Duration: 6 months

Sabena Engineering is a leading independent and international aviation solutions provider for civil and military operators. 
 

Our capabilities cover the main aircraft types, including Airbus, Boeing, Lockheed, regional and military aircraft and rotor aircraft. With our unique and innovative solutions to both regular and complex needs, Sabena Engineering is all set to grow as a worldwide proximity partner, bringing its expertise wherever needed. SABCA offers a full range of services to the civil, space and military aviation markets and recently expanded into the commercial Unmanned Autonomous Systems market as an integrator of aerospace-grade solutions for the industry. 
 

Sabena Aerospace & SABCA are part of a unique industrial ecosystem in the Belgian aerospace industry which is owned by Sabena Aerospace (holding company) and by the Société Fédérale de Participations et d’Investissements (SFPI/FPIM).
 

Are you ready to join us?
 

Your Main Responsibilities:
 

Reporting to the Head of Engine Services, you will be required to perform the following: 
 
 

• Engine Incoming Inspection 

• Engine Storage, Humidity Checks and Humidity Corrections 

• Engine Preservation 

• Engine Boroscope inspection 

• Engine Boroblending  

• Engine handling, QEC removal and installation 

• Engine inspection at major module level, Inventory Checks and Lease Return Work Scope (LRWS) / C-Checks iaw B-rating 

• Engine Identification Plug TST/REP iaw C-rating 

• Replacement of external engine parts 

• Maintain and operate ES tooling 

• Maintain and follow-up of local products 
 

• Full understanding of ATA 100 system and working knowledge of interactions between AMM, ESM, CMM 

• Capability of reading, understanding and implementation of service bulletins and airworthy documentation 

• Ability to converse and understand English language at a high level 

• High level of reading and writing technical English is a must 

• High level of computer literacy will be required for daily tasks 

• Have the ability to work within a small team and act independently when required 

• You have a part 66 B1, B1/B2, B1/C or B1/B2/ C license or equivalent shop training/experience on CFM56 and/or V2500 and/or LEAP 1A/1B engines

Bring your office management expertise to a role where you can make an impact from day one, with a wide range of responsibilities and opportunities to shape the workplace experience.

Join Bird & Bird Brussels and play a key role in creating a welcoming, efficient and well-supported workplace within a leading international law firm.

• Dynamic, innovative, and internationally renowned law firm advising clients across sectors including technology, communications, life sciences, financial services, automotive and energy. 
• Established reputation for delivering exceptional service and exceeding client expectations, Bird & Bird is known for helping clients navigate change and seize opportunity.
• International presence with 34 offices across Europe, the Middle East, Asia-Pacific and North America.
• Enjoy a friendly and inclusive work environment based on respect and understanding.
• Comprehensive onboarding to help you settle at your own pace.
• Continuous learning via monthly webinars, training sessions and online resources 
• Realize your career aspirations within this multicultural team, 85 professionals, 10 different nationalities. 
• Modern and attractive offices (presently being refurbished), conveniently accessible by public transport.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l3U2I59NpoY 

Jobomschrijving

As Office Manager, you will be at the heart of the Brussels office, ensuring that everything runs smoothly. You will combine service excellence and operational responsibility whilst working closely with local and international teams to support the day-to-day running of the office and contribute to wider firm initiatives.

Your Responsibilities

• Manage facilities and office services, ensuring the workplace is well equipped, maintained and ready to support colleagues' daily work. 
• Shape the workplace and employee experience to support team growth by identifying practical opportunities to make the Brussels office more welcoming, efficient and well organised. 
• Lead and develop the reception team, creating a high-quality experience for colleagues, clients and visitors.
• In collaboration with diverse stakeholders (HR, IT, Marketing, the Social Committee as well as international teams) coordinate and deliver office projects and events including client seminars and team building initiatives 
• Build and manage strong supplier relationships, ensuring quality service and value for money. 
• Contribute to Health & Safety, Security, Risk Management, Business Continuity and GDPR  helping maintain a safe and supportive workplace. 
• Encourage ESG initiatives and contribute to the firm's sustainability objectives in Brussels. 
• Participate in the global Office Management quarterly meetings, sharing best practices and bringing innovative ideas to the Brussels office. 

• You have minimum 5 years’ experience in Office Management and an interest in how office management is evolving through new systems and technologies. 
• Excellent English, with good knowledge of Dutch and French
• A proactive and motivating leadership style.
• Clear and confident communication skills.
• A collaborative "one team" mindset, enabling you to build strong working relationships.
• Integrity, professionalism and a strong sense of ownership.
• A creative and practical approach to problem-solving.

Looking for a flexible student job during the academic year 2026-2027?

We are currently looking for enthusiastic and motivated students to join our warehouse team at Katoen Natie Kallo.

You'll start working from mid to late September and begin with a commitment of 2 days per week. This is an excellent opportunity to gain valuable work experience, develop new skills, and become part of a dynamic international logistics company.

What's in it for you?

 
• Flexible student job alongside your studies
 
• Hands-on experience in a large logistics environment
 
• A supportive team and professional guidance
 
• The opportunity to grow within the company

Please note that we cannot guarantee full-time work during school holidays. However, students who show commitment, perform well, and still have sufficient student hours available will have the opportunity to work more frequently during holiday periods and continue their student job throughout the 2027-2028 academic year.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you! Join our team and gain valuable experience while earning extra income during your studies.

 What you'll be doing:
 

 
•  
Willing to do physical work — boxes can weigh between 10 kg and 20 kg.
 
 
•  
You should be flexible to help with all kinds of warehouse tasks, such as loading and unloading, picking, packing, labeling, receiving, and other general warehouse duties.
 
 

English required.

We are currently looking for a motivated Terberg - Tugmaster driver (CE driver) for internal transport at Katoen Natie Gent. In this role, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently carrying out internal transport using a Terberg - Tugmaster tractor. You will be involved in moving goods and materials within our logistics environment and ensuring they are delivered to the correct locations.

 

 

• Operating the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor to move goods and materials within the facility.

• Loading and unloading trucks using the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor.

• Carefully checking goods and materials to ensure they match the corresponding documentation.

• Recording completed tasks and keeping track of inventory levels.

• Compliance with safety regulations and ensuring a safe working environment.

 

 

 

• Demonstrable experience as a Terberg - Tugmaster driver or operating similar tractors.

• You have a valid CE driver's license and code 95.

• Knowledge of applicable laws and regulations regarding internal transport.

• Familiarity with safety regulations and the ability to apply them correctly.

• Good communication skills in Dutch and/or English to effectively interact with colleagues.

• You are motivated and reliable and value safety and quality.

• You are flexible regarding hours and tasks.

• Willingness to work in two shifts or nightshift

• Good physical condition and capable of performing prolonged seated work.

• Attention to detail and precise execution of tasks.

• Expirience with a forklift long vorks is a plus!

In addition, you sometimes help with other tasks in the warehouse (order picking, receiving, stock counting, etc.). For this, you will use a scanner.You will start in the Katoen Natie warehouses in Ghent.

Profile

• You have experience with a forklift truck with long forks (2m40) or you have extensive experience with a forklift truck with short forks and you see yourself driving the long-fork truck as well.

• A forklift certificate is not a requirement, experience is more important. There will be a theoretical and practical test

• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, you speak and understand Dutch or English well.

• You can work in a two-shift system

• You are motivated and reliable, and you prize safety and quality.

• You are flexible when it comes to hours and tasks

• In addition, you know how to use a scanner and a computer

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide, inspire, and work alongside a dedicated team of warehouse professionals while ensuring operational excellence in our fast-paced international logistics environment.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standards

Operational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processes

Hands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when needed

Performance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiatives

Critical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situations

Safety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all times

Reporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational management

Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Essential Requirements:

3+ years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environments

Forklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)

Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)

Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlines

Physical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feet

Flexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekends

Problem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experience

Experience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)

Knowledge of customs procedures and international shipping

Lean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experience

Multilingual capabilities for our international client base

As a reach truck driver, you are one of the most important links in the Katoen Natie warehouse in Ghent. You are responsible for storing and preparing valuable materials. Using the reach truck, you regularly stock goods on high racks. This requires an eye for detail and safety.

 

Profile

• Physical work doesn't put you off, you like to roll up your sleeves

Just graduated and have recently obtained your bachelor's degree? Interested in a leadership role? Our client, Katoen Natie in Ghent, has a vacancy for a Supply Chain Trainee.

 

 

Grow into a leadership position with the Supply Chain Traineeship

 

 

As a Supply Chain Trainee, you will have the opportunity to advance to a leadership role within one of our logistics operations within a span of 2 years. Your logistics career will take off with an extensive on-the-job training program lasting approximately 2 years. The emphasis is on developing operational skills, leadership qualities, and specialization.

 

A diverse journey.

 

 

Throughout this exploratory experience, you will have the chance to become familiar with various operations and clients. This will enable you to discover the possibilities available to you within the company. There will be a total of 4 evaluation moments during the program. Depending on your competencies and interests, you may progress to a leadership position, such as a team leader overseeing a team/department and being responsible for guiding and coaching your team within a specific department.

 

 

 

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.

• Or you have an A2 diploma with relevant work experience, such as team leader, shift leader, supervisor, logistics employee, forklift driver, ambitious warehouse employee, etc.

• You speak fluent English and Dutch

• You are a true people manager and enjoy leading others.

• You can remain calm in stressful situations and are willing to make decisions.

• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively get things done.

• You are willing to invest in yourself, you are driven and eager to learn.

• You are flexible in terms of working hours (shifts) and tasks.

As a logistical inventory specialist, you strengthen the team of order pickers at Kuehne+Nagel in Geel working in 2 shifts for €16,3753/hour and meal vouchers.

You fulfill a versatile key position as a logistical inventory specialist, combining the physical order picking of famous toy products with the administrative follow-up of inventory and quality controls. Thanks to your sharp eye and accurate way of working, your contribution as a logistical inventory specialist guarantees a flawless logistical process. 

Ready to take the next step as an order picker? Aply via talentcenter4@randstad.be or 014 24 86 60!

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for?

• At least 6 months of demonstrable experience within the logistics sector.
• Practical experience with a hand scanner and administrative follow-up.
• Good command of either the Dutch or English language.
• Willingness to work in a 2-shift system.
• Possession of your own transport to reach the location in Geel.
Key responsibilities

• Physically collecting toy goods and orders using a hand scanner.
• Performing thorough quality checks on picked orders from colleague order pickers.
• Monitoring stock levels and supporting warehouse administration.
• Spotting and correcting inventory discrepancies at an early stage.

For the campus of DHL in Bornem, we are looking for order pickers with ETP experience and the necessary ETP certificate. You will work in a dynamic team, where you will work in the alternating shift (6 a.m. to 2 p.m. & 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.). 
 

As an order picker, your duties will include the following tasks: 
 

 
• Collecting/picking orders using a ETP
 
• Applying shipping labels to orders
 
• Loading and unloading trucks, this can be either manually or with an electric transpallet (ETP). 
 
• Taking care of administration: this may involve processing delivery notes 
 
• Quality control of goods dn packaging of goods.
 
• We are looking for order pickers who are keen to prove themselves across the warehouse and in any position. 

As an order picker, you can relate to the following description: 
 

 
• You already have experience in the logistics sector.
 
• You have your own transport to get to the warehouse. (Not accessible by public transport )
 
• You are enthusiastic about taking up a new challenge.
 
• You can perform your tasks accurately and correctly.
 
• A real team player.
 
• You are stress-resistant and always remain customer-friendly under difficult circumstances.
 
• You consider quality of paramount importance.
 
• A good basic knowledge of Dutch or English.

An international Belgian software developer builds its own innovative SaaS solutions for the manufacturing industry. Their software helps manufacturing companies worldwide work smarter, more efficiently, and in a more automated way. Within their Cloud Development team, they are working on a modern, cloud-native solution that is being further built from the ground up using technologies such as .NET and Azure.
In addition, they actively work with AI tools such as Claude Code within an agentic engineering context.
Due to expansion and their continued success, they are currently looking for strong profiles.

Jobomschrijving

They have a strong IT department, and you will join an agile development subteam that works in short sprints on modern cloud-native software. You will take ownership within the team and work together with software engineers, UX designers, product managers, and DevOps profiles to build scalable solutions.
In addition to hands-on development in .NET, you will actively contribute to discussions around architecture, technical choices, quality, and further product development. You will use AI tools to increase your own productivity and that of the team, while remaining personally responsible for the quality and outcome of the work.
You will explore new technologies and AI applications to improve both the development process and the performance of the product. In addition, you will contribute to concrete AI use cases within the software and help the team grow through technical guidance, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or similar
• Strong professional experience in .NET development
• Interest in AI tools
• You work in English, Dutch is a plus

At the request of business stakeholders, the candidate analyzes, configures, and codes application software components in accordance with specified changes, standards, and procedures.
Key responsibilities

• Analyze business requirements to define software specifications and perform detailed technical studies

• Configure ERP application packages and develop prototypes

• Develop and test software modules, including unit and integration testing, and resolve defects

• Assemble software components and produce corresponding documentation

• Execute corrective and evolutionary maintenance and manage reusable software components

• Technical analysis

• ERP configuration

• Prototyping

• Unit and integration testing

• Software documentation

• Software maintenance

Qualifications

• Between 3 and 5 years of experience in .NET development

• Between 3 and 5 years of professional use of English
